images.title: A1 · Genesis · Over the Fallen Beech
images.intent: An alderkin moving decisively through its territory; test action without losing broad readable bark forms.
images.prompt:
Create a new active scene by transforming the supplied Breachline character painting. Preserve the successful coherent painted finish and the character's recognizable design, but completely replace the pose and composition with the described action. ONE finished landscape painting1536x1024, no sheet, no panels/text/signature. Traditional oil painting, clear large connected value masses, richly observed restrained color, matte skin cloth and bark, gradual modest changes in detail, clear silhouettes and weight-bearing anatomy. Detail follows form; no scratchy contour tracing, dashes scattered on top, palette-knife confetti, photoreal face pasted on loose surroundings, digital wax or game-render gloss. Background remains plainly intelligible without camera blur. The motion must come from a clear physical action and balance, not ribbons of visual effects. Breachline high fantasy150years after imperial collapse.
The same willow alderkin now reacts decisively to an intruder beyond frame. It is bounding left-to-right across a massive mossy fallen beech in a dark woodland clearing, three-quarter side view, body occupying middle two thirds. One root-foot plants solidly on top of the trunk; the other root-leg is bent and driving through the stride, clearly separated. The near long branch-hand grips one simple straight wooden staff/spear held forward at a slight upward angle; the far arm sweeps back for balance. Upright open trunk leans toward its destination; head looks sharply forward, not down or contemplatively away. Dark knot eyes intent, angular head purposeful without cartoon rage. No hand on chest.
Preserve naturally grown asymmetric treelike anatomy: a few major woody uprights forming an OPEN trunk, branch arms, root legs, spare russet leaf crown; no human torso muscles, rubber bark suit or human face. Make the trunk openings legible against a quiet pale green distant gap. Main branches and legs fully inside frame; some minor foliage movement. Cool deep bottle green woodland, a narrow warm overcast light patch catching one shoulder and the staff. Broad readable bark, few quiet ferns, 3 major trunks; reduce little leaf marks. A credible instant of momentum and independent territorial purpose. No other figure, no water infrastructure, no sleepy idyll.
images.assistant_review: Clear forward movement and territorial intent; open trunk and root-leg contact remain readable. Pending review.
